# Tanit XR

> A volunteer nonprofit preserving Tunisia's endangered cultural heritage in 3D, AR and VR,
> and publishing it free for anyone to use. Volunteers in Tunisia, the United States, Europe
> and Nigeria scan sites and objects with phones and cameras, turn them into 3D models, research
> their history, and build immersive experiences. Fiscally sponsored by Florida Community
> Innovation, a US 501(c)(3). Founded and led by Ines Said.

Everything on this site is free to read, quote and link. Please credit Tanit XR and link back
to https://tanitxr.org/. Last updated 2026-09-25.

## What people usually want

- [Explore in 3D](https://tanitxr.org/explore/): the collection in the browser, one object at a time, no app or headset needed. Works in VR headsets too.
- [Art, XR and Impact Opportunities](https://tanitxr.org/opportunities/): a free curated board of grants, residencies, fellowships, open calls and events for artists, XR creators, educators, students and changemakers. Also sent free by email.
- [The archive](https://tanitxr.org/archive/): every 3D scan, each with its own page, history and downloadable or viewable model.
- [Volunteer](https://tanitxr.org/volunteer/): how to join, no archaeology or 3D background needed.
- [Partner with us](https://tanitxr.org/partners/): for companies and foundations.
- [Contact](https://tanitxr.org/contact/): info@tanitxr.org

## Pages

## Open calls and opportunities, curated by Tanit XR

Updated 2026-09-25. Full board with filters: https://tanitxr.org/opportunities/

- The Kyoto Retreat 2026 (Residency, In-person, , deadline July 15, 2026): The Kyoto Retreat is a four-week international artist retreat in Kyoto, Japan, open to artists, curators, and writers at all career stages. Selected participants receive a roundtrip flight, private accommodation, and $800 USD for meals and local transport. https://www.kyotoretreat.com
- HTW Berlin – IUNO AI + XR Artistic Fellowship 2026 (Fellowship, In-person, , deadline March 31, 2026): HTW Berlin’s IUNO project is an EU-funded research initiative supporting artists at the intersection of AI and XR. The selected artist or team will co-develop a project at HTW Berlin from May 2026 to January 2027, with access to equipment, mentorship, a scientific paper publication, and public networking events. https://www.berlinartlink.com/2026/02/17/open-call-htw-berlin-artistic-fellowship-ai-xr/
- RAY Fellowship Program 2026 (Fellowship, In-person, , deadline March 27, 2026): The RAY Fellowship Program places emerging leaders in two-year paid fellowships at conservation and clean energy organisations across the United States. Open to recent graduates within three years of their undergraduate degree who have not yet worked full-time in conservation or clean energy. https://www.rayfellows.org/apply
- Changemakers for Youth Program 2026 (Program, Hybrid, , deadline March 29, 2026): ChangemakerXchange is selecting 20 social entrepreneurs from Egypt, Germany, Jordan, Lebanon, Morocco, Palestine, Switzerland, and Tunisia. Participants receive capacity-building support, an in-person summit, seed funding for cross-border initiatives, and access to a global changemaker network. https://opportunitydesk.org/2026/02/04/changemakers-for-youth-program-2026/
- Creative Capital Award 2027 (Grant, Remote, , deadline April 2, 2026): Creative Capital supports bold, experimental artistic projects across all disciplines through grants of $15,000 to $50,000. Open to working artists based in the United States with at least five years of professional practice. Individual artists and collaborative teams may apply. https://creative-capital.org/applicationhandbook
- AWE 2026 – Startup Pitch Competition (Open Call, In-person, , deadline April 21, 2026): AWE USA 2026 is hosting a Startup Pitch Competition where select AR and VR startups pitch in front of experienced XR investors. Selected artists are displayed for all four days of the event, invited to speak on stage, and may be eligible for a travel stipend. https://www.awexr.com/art-festival

- Morgan-Menil Fellowship 2026-27 (Drawing Institute) (Fellowship, In-person, , deadline December 15, 2025): The Morgan Drawing Institute and the Menil Drawing Institute (Houston) offer a 3-9 month research fellowship supporting independent projects on the history, theory, interpretation, or cultural meaning of drawing. The Morgan-Menil Fellow is expected to spend part of the fellowship in residence at The Morgan Library & Museum (New York) and another part at the Menil Collection, with time devoted primarily to the research project and participation in Drawing Institute programs. Stipend is commensurate with experience: $4,000/month (pre-doctoral), $4,850/month (post-doctoral within seven years of PhD), or $5,100/month (mid-career), plus a modest travel allowance. Application deadline: December 15, 2025.

Proposals are a maximum of three pages plus two pages of supplementary material, submitted through PCS by October 1, 2026; there is no submission fee, and the organizers are preferably at least two people from two different organizations. At least one organizer must register and attend in person at the David L. Lawrence Convention Center in Pittsburgh, May 10 to 14, 2027, or the meet-up is cancelled. https://chi2027.acm.org/authors/meet-ups/
- iLRN 2027, 13th Immersive Learning Research Network Conference (Conference, Hybrid, Global, deadline October 4, 2026): Annual conference on immersive learning, themed "XR + AI Collaboration", held online June 11-13, 2027 and in person June 26-29, 2027 at Kyungpook National University in Daegu, Republic of Korea. The Academic Stream closes October 4, 2026 and takes full papers (12-15 pages, published in Scopus-indexed Springer CCIS), short papers (8-11 pages), extended abstracts of 4-7 pages for a poster, and doctoral colloquium papers. The practitioner iLEAD stream, which takes 2-5 page extended abstracts for talks, posters, workshops, panels, guided virtual adventures and product demos, closes January 12, 2027; accepted authors must register, and online presenters submit a 3-5 minute pre-recorded video. https://www.immersivelrn.org/ilrn2027/call-for-proposals/
- Wijhat (Destinations), Culture Resource Mobility Grants (Grant, In-person, MENA, deadline January 16, 2027): Up to 7,000 euros for artists and cultural actors from the Arab region to travel for professional purposes: fairs, artistic residencies, forums, conferences, seminars and training or capacity-building workshops. The grant covers flights, visa costs, accommodation, internal transport and partial living expenses, and Culture Resource can write a supporting letter to the relevant embassy after the contract is signed. Either the departure or the arrival country must be in the Arab region; individuals and groups may apply, and there is no application fee. Applications are accepted year-round and judged in three rounds, with cut-offs at 16:00 Beirut time on January 16 (results February 28), May 29 (results July 1) and September 17 (results October 31); the activity you are travelling for must fall after the results date of the round you apply to. https://mawred.org/artistic-creativity/wijhat/?lang=en
- XR Women Museum, Community Garden (Open Call, Remote, Global, Rolling): Ongoing call from the XR Women Museum for contributions to its Community Garden: 3D and XR-ready objects, animated or interactive “pollinators”, botanical or spatial fragments, and conceptual world-building elements. The museum describes it as a living relational system rather than a submission pool for selection, so contributions join an evolving XR ecosystem that outlasts any single exhibition. Submissions go through a Google form linked from the museum page and there is no fee or published closing date. https://www.xrwomen.com/museum
- NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 (Challenge, Hybrid, Global, deadline November 14, 2026): The world's largest annual space and science hackathon, run by NASA with 17 partner space agencies, held November 14 to 15, 2026. Registration is open and free, and the site lists 14 challenges plus local in-person events by city alongside a fully remote option; teams form on the platform. Open to anyone interested in space and science, at any age, skill level or professional background. https://www.spaceappschallenge.org/
- Habibi Tech Summit 2026, Volunteer Call (Open Call, In-person, North America, deadline September 25, 2026): Volunteer at the Habibi Tech Summit, held September 25 and 26, 2026 across three New York City venues in Brooklyn, Manhattan and Queens. Six roles are open: guests and registration, content creation, program and stage, exhibitors and sponsors, setup and logistics, and flexible assignment. Volunteers work one shift and attend the rest of the day as a guest at no cost. No experience is required and sign-up is through the form on the volunteers page; shifts close once they fill. https://habibi.tech/volunteers

Lawrence Convention Center in Pittsburgh. Proposals run up to six pages excluding references, use the ACM Master Article single-column template, and go through the PCS system with an abstract, motivation, organizer information, planned activities and a 250-word call for participation. Free to submit. Organizers are expected to have prior conference or reviewing experience, and selection is competitive. https://chi2027.acm.org/authors/workshops/

The commitment is about eight hours of reviewing between October and November 2026. Free. They ask for previous conference involvement or reviewing experience and regular CHI attendance as a speaker, author or attendee. https://chi2027.acm.org/authors/workshops/
